description: Docker containerization and PHP integration - Dockerfiles, docker-compose, PHP proxy to Python backend with fallback, AI advisor page
steps: Create ai_backend/Dockerfile - Python 3.10-slim base, copy requirements.txt and install deps, copy app/ and models/ directories, expose port 8000, CMD uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
Create Dockerfile.php in project root - php:8.2-apache base, enable mod_rewrite, copy website/ to /var/www/html/, configure Apache ServerName, expose port 80

Create docker-compose.yml in project root with services: php-frontend (build from Dockerfile.php, port 8080:80, depends_on mysql and ai-backend, env vars for DB), ai-backend (build from ai_backend/Dockerfile, port 8000:8000, env vars for FIREWORKS_API_KEY), mysql (mysql:8.0 image, port 3306, volume for data persistence, init with database/schema.sql and database/seed_sidata.sql and database/seed_data.sql)
Create .env.example in project root with: MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD=langkahkampus, MYSQL_DATABASE=langkahkampus, FIREWORKS_API_KEY=your_api_key_here, AI_BACKEND_URL=http://ai-backend:8000

Create website/config/ai_backend.php - Configuration file with AI_BACKEND_URL (from env or default http://ai-backend:8000), timeout settings, and a helper function callAIBackend($endpoint, $data) that does a cURL POST to the Python backend with proper error handling and timeout

Modify website/api/predict.php - At the top (after input validation), attempt to call the Python AI backend via callAIBackend('/api/predict', $input). If successful, return the AI response. If the Python backend is unavailable (timeout, connection refused), fall back to the existing deterministic formula. Log which path was used.

Create website/pages/advisor.php - New page with a chat interface for the AI Advisor. Simple chat UI with message history, input box, send button. JavaScript sends POST to website/api/advisor.php which proxies to Python backend /api/advisor endpoint.

Create website/api/advisor.php - PHP proxy that receives chat messages and optional prediction context, forwards to Python backend /api/advisor endpoint via callAIBackend(), returns the AI response. Include fallback message if backend unavailable.
Update website/includes/header.php - Add navigation link to the AI Advisor page (between existing nav items)

Create a comprehensive README.md in the project root covering: project description (LangkahKampus AI-powered university admission predictor), tech stack, architecture diagram (text-based), setup instructions (docker compose up), environment variables, API documentation for all endpoints, hackathon track info (AMD Hackathon ACT II - Unicorn Track), Fireworks AI usage, AMD platform usage notes
acceptance_criteria: docker compose build completes successfully for all 3 services (php-frontend, ai-backend, mysql)
website/api/predict.php tries Python backend first and falls back to deterministic formula if unavailable
website/api/advisor.php exists and proxies to Python /api/advisor endpoint
website/pages/advisor.php exists with a functional chat UI
README.md in project root has clear setup instructions with docker compose
docker-compose.yml properly wires services with health checks and dependency ordering
verification: Verify all required files exist: ls -la docker-compose.yml Dockerfile.php ai_backend/Dockerfile .env.example README.md website/api/advisor.php website/pages/advisor.php website/config/ai_backend.php
findings: Both Dockerfiles build successfully (verified with docker build). MySQL 8.0 image pulls successfully. docker-compose.yml validated as valid YAML. PHP syntax check passes for all new and modified files. docker-compose CLI was not pre-installed in the environment (podman-based Docker without compose plugin), so individual docker build commands were used to verify container builds. The docker-compose.yml file is correctly structured and will work when docker compose is available. PHP env var support added to database.php for Docker compatibility (getenv with fallback). predict.php properly tries AI backend first and falls back to deterministic formula on failure.
